about_the_game:
Bounce It is a fast-paced arcade game built around one core rule:
Keep the ball bouncing from side to side.

Each bounce keeps you in the game. Time your inputs well to maintain the rhythm and stay on track. Across every game mode, the challenge is to keep the motion going while adapting to new patterns, obstacles, and setups. Score higher, survive longer, and unlock new content as you go.

Earn experience by completing levels and improving your score. As you level up, you’ll unlock skin tokens to get skins and visual effects to personalize your experience.

Core Features

  • Signature Bounce Mechanic
    A satisfying side-to-side bounce that defines every mode and challenge.

  • Progression Through Play
    Gain experience by reaching milestones, and improving your runs.

  • Unlockable Skins
    Customize your ball, bouncer, particles, trail and much more!

  • Endless Score Runs
    Push your skills to the limit in endless modes.

  • Minimalist Visuals with Focused Gameplay
    Clean, readable presentation designed to keep you immersed and in control.

Developer Note

Bounce It is my first experimental Steam project, created mainly as a way to learn and grow as a developer. It is a compact arcade game about surviving by bouncing, refined through feedback along the way. While it’s not meant as a polished commercial product, I will continue supporting it based on what players enjoy most.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 260X or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
